caption:
How many of these 5 do you do before shopping? Count and comment your score.

Swipe through 5 simple habits: check the fridge, plan dinners a few days ahead, buy recipe quantities, cook what expires first, and log what came home. Points 2, 3 and 5 are built into WE.LIFE: meal plan, list with quantities and pantry.

WE.LIFE is a Life OS for everyday life, and Food OS is its first module. The link to the free WE.LIFE beta is in our bio @welife.world. This is a beta (test) version.
